documents.title: Twilight
documents.description: The mechanism common to every Slot: how work becomes a reward, Slot registration, the token supply and halving, how a Slot's share is distributed, the authorization server (MINIS: enrollment, epochs, eligibility, settlement), the coding-agent client (install, agents, wallet, identity), then the reference: CLI, config, files, agent hosts, the mining protocol, chain parameters, hosts, versions.

documents.title: Search router (Slot 3)
documents.description: The one Slot open today: how a search becomes a reward, searching and the fan-out, the API key, trajectories (what travels with a search and how to turn it off), how the Slot distributes tokens (what counts as a verified search, how the share is split, why trajectories), then the reference: router API, tiers and cost, status codes, traces, feedback and judge, the verification API, the trace envelope, hosts.

documents.title: Agent skill: dropin-miner (template)
documents.description: The skill dropin-miner agents install renders for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; {{SEARCH}} and {{PREFER}} are filled at install.

install.how: run `dropin-miner agents install`; do not hand-write this file, the binary renders it with your paths
